# https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots/intro
# Generated by tools/build.js. Do not edit by hand; edit site.config.js.

# One group per user agent, checked at build time. Everything is allowed and
# nothing is disallowed: /contact/sent/ is kept out of search with a noindex
# tag, which only works if the page can be crawled and read.

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-input=yes,ai-train=yes,use=full
Allow: /

# Named individually so that restricting the wildcard above can never cut them
# off by accident: a crawler that matches its own group ignores the wildcard
# group entirely. Picsel sells being the answer an assistant gives.
# OpenAI, training and browsing
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

# OpenAI, search index
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /
